english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a business sector or trade.
This is the all-purpose choice for a field of economic activity.
Use this for the trade, line of work, or professional field rather than one person's particular job.
Use this for a skilled trade, occupation, or line of business, as in a carpenter's trade.
Use this for someone's line of work or an industry, rather than for one particular business venture.
